title: Craft Spawner And Egg
description: This mod add craft for spawner and many egg (Many eggs are not added, such as boss eggs or eggs from useless creatures, for example, foxes.)
body: This Minecraft mod introduces a powerful new crafting system that allows players to create mob spawners and spawn eggs directly in survival mode. By gathering rare and valuable resources, players can unlock recipes to craft spawners for their favorite mobs, as well as corresponding spawn eggs. This feature adds a new layer of strategy and progression, making it easier to build custom farms, test mechanics, or create unique challenges. Balanced recipes ensure that crafting remains fair and rewarding, while still giving players more control over their world. Perfect for both survival and creative-style gameplay enhancements!
